Title: Product Name & Live URL
Description: PROTOMANIA: AI Fitness, Nutrition & Budget Optimizer for Indian youth. Live at https://proto-mania-jms1.vercel.app/. Tagline: Your Body. Your Budget. Your Era.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Public production deployment on Vercel with 99.9% uptime and active HTTPS.

Title: Target Market & Collegiate Audience
Description: 40+ Million Indian college and university students living in hostels, PGs, and shared flats on strict daily food allowances (₹30 to ₹150/day).
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Addressable market reach across tier-1, tier-2, and tier-3 Indian university clusters.

Title: Core Technology Stack
Description: Backend: Python 3.14 + FastAPI + Starlette + SQLite3 Relational DB; Frontend: Tailwind CSS + Responsive HTML5/Vanilla ES6; Deployment: Vercel Serverless.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Zero external heavy JS framework dependencies; API latency < 300ms; sub-50ms client tab switching.

Title: Product Vision Statement
Description: To democratize athletic physical transformation for India's 40+ million college students by proving that peak hypertrophy, health, and athletic discipline do not require wealth, luxury gym memberships, or expensive foreign supplements — only intelligent algorithms, accessible Indian staples, and relentless consistency.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Long-term brand equity as India's definitive student fitness & nutrition platform.

Title: Product Mission Statement
Description: To engineer the world's most accessible, culturally native, and budget-constrained fitness companion for youth. We eliminate the financial and operational barriers of hostel living through deterministic knapsack budget nutrition, campus mess navigation, and privacy-first peer accountability.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Deliver 100% accessible nutrition plans requiring zero kitchen appliances beyond an electric kettle.

Title: Pillar 1: Deterministic Budget Optimization (Grams of Protein per ₹)
Description: Fitness nutrition is treated as a mathematically constrained knapsack optimization problem. The engine algorithmically maximizes bioavailable protein yield per rupee within hard student pocket-money boundaries (₹30 to ₹150/day).
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Deliver >= 85g bioavailable protein on ₹80/day budget (P/₹ ratio >= 1.05g/₹).

Title: Pillar 2: Living Reality Native (Hostel, Mess & Zero-Cook)
Description: Tailored specifically around dorm living realities: no modular kitchen, no private refrigerator, watered-down mess lentils, and electric kettle cooking. If a student cannot cook or buy it on campus, it is excluded from PROTOMANIA.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: 100% of generated meals executable in 3 living environments: Hostel Kettle, Mess Survival, or Zero-Cook Desk.

Title: Pillar 3: Cultural Food Authenticity
Description: Replaces Western macro templates (salmon, quinoa, avocado, Greek yogurt) with accessible, affordable Indian staples: Soya Chunks, Sattu, Whole Eggs, Peanuts, Roasted Chana, Besan/Moong Chillas, Dahi, Paneer, Rohu Fish, and Homestyle Chicken Curry.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Zero foreign imported supplement dependencies; 100% ingredients purchasable at any campus Kirana store.

Title: Pillar 4: Gen-Z Social Dynamics & Habit Gamification
Description: Sustains daily consistency through Anabolic XP (+50 XP per meal logged), Ranks (Iron Cadet to Campus Beast), consistency streaks, private hostel squads, and Spotify-style shareable recaps (Fitness Wrapped).
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Achieve >= 45% Day-30 user retention and > 250 campus hostel squads created.

Title: Moat 1: Hard Financial Boundary vs Unconstrained Trackers
Description: Legacy apps (MyFitnessPal, HealthifyMe) assume unconstrained food budgets and Western catalogs. PROTOMANIA operates strictly within student pocket money limits (₹60, ₹80, ₹100, ₹120, ₹150/day) with mathematical knapsack efficiency.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: 100% plans respect hard student budget upper bounds without budget overflow.

Title: Moat 2: Hostel Dorm Equipment Constraint Awareness
Description: Unlike commercial diet apps that mandate 4-burner stoves, blenders, and ovens, PROTOMANIA filters recipes strictly by kettle boiling, hot water soaking, or zero-cook campus Kirana staples.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Zero recipes requiring oven, food processor, or refrigeration.

Title: Moat 3: Protein-per-Rupee Price Radar with Kirana Overrides
Description: Dynamic cost index ranking every Indian staple by ₹/10g protein (e.g. Soya Chunks @ ₹3.5/10g, Sattu @ ₹4.5/10g, Eggs @ ₹6.5/10g). Allows campus students to override local egg/sattu market prices.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Real-time recalculated meal budgets based on student campus Kirana custom prices.

Title: Dimension 1: Target Demographic Comparison
Description: Legacy Apps: Salaried corporate adults (₹50k+/mo income); Commercial Gyms: Affluent urban gym-goers; PROTOMANIA: College students living on ₹1k–₹4k monthly food stipend.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: 100% tailored for student purchasing power.

Title: Dimension 2: Budget Constraint Comparison
Description: Legacy Apps: Completely unconstrained; assumes grocery delivery; Commercial Gyms: Assumes paid personal coaches and ₹3,000/mo whey protein; PROTOMANIA: Hard mathematical knapsack optimizer (₹60, ₹80, ₹100, ₹120/day).
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Deterministic compliance with daily rupee budgets.

Title: Dimension 3: Cooking & Kitchen Reality Comparison
Description: Legacy Apps: Assumes fully equipped kitchen & fridge; Commercial Gyms: Assumes pre-packaged diet subscription meals; PROTOMANIA: Hostel electric kettle, desk zero-cook & mess survival modes.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Zero kitchen equipment prerequisites.

Title: Dimension 4: Food Catalog & Indexing Comparison
Description: Legacy Apps: European/US catalog or unverified user entries; Commercial Gyms: Western templates (avocado, Greek yogurt); PROTOMANIA: Authentic Indian staples ranked by cost per 10g protein (₹/10g).
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Zero unverified catalog items; 100% Indian Kirana staples.

Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Target: 5,000,000 grams of budget-optimized protein logged weekly across campus cohorts.

Description: KR 1.1: Onboard 50,000 active Indian university students across 10 major campus clusters. KR 1.2: Achieve >= 45% Day-30 retention powered by gamified XP streaks.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: 50,000 student accounts; 45% D-30 retention rate.

Title: Objective 2: Student Financial & Nutritional Efficiency
Description: KR 2.1: Maintain average daily protein intake > 85g for students on an ₹80/day budget. KR 2.2: Save students an aggregate of ₹1.5 Crore vs commercial whey supplements.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Average intake >= 85g protein/day; aggregate user savings >= ₹1.5 Cr.

Title: Problem Statement: Collegiate Protein Malnutrition & Economic Barrier
Description: 73% of collegiate youth in India are protein-deficient (ICMR). Messes rely heavily on cheap carb fillers (refined flour, potato curries, watery dal). Commercial whey protein (₹2,200–₹3,500/kg) is impossible on ₹2,000–₹4,000 monthly food stipends. PROTOMANIA bridges this gap mathematically using local Indian staples.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Close collegiate protein gap by providing high-protein solutions starting at ₹40/day.

Title: Scope: Product Goals (In Scope)
Description: 1. Mifflin-St Jeor biometric calculator. 2. Heuristic knapsack solver for ₹60–₹150+ tiers. 3. 7-day day-wise meal planner (Mon–Sun). 4. 7-day bulk grocery haul generator. 5. Real-time command center dashboard with +50 XP logging. 6. Campus gamification & hostel squads. 7. Hostel mess menu deficit compensator.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: All 7 functional scope items fully operational in production web platform.

Title: Scope: Explicit Non-Goals (Out of Scope)
Description: 1. Direct grocery ecommerce checkout/delivery (procurement list generated for Kirana; no logistics handling). 2. Clinical pathology or metabolic disease dietetics. 3. Heavy workout video streaming (focus is strictly pocket-money nutrition and diet planning).
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Platform maintains zero clinical liability and zero grocery fulfillment overhead.

Title: Phase 1: Biometric & Pocket-Money Onboarding Flow
Description: Student launches 5-step wizard -> Inputs sex, age, height, weight, activity -> Declares daily pocket money (e.g. ₹80/day) -> Selects living constraint (Hostel/Mess/Zero-Cook) -> System calculates BMR, TDEE, protein targets -> Awards +150 XP on completion.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Wizard completion rate > 80%; completion time < 90 seconds.

Title: Phase 2: Algorithmic Meal Optimization Flow
Description: Student opens Diet Plans -> Selects budget tier (₹60, ₹80, ₹100, ₹120, ₹150) -> Selects day tab (Mon to Sun) -> Views meal timings, cooking instructions, macros, and price breakdown -> Toggles Veg/Egg/Non-Veg mode instantaneously.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Plan generation in < 150ms; zero page reload during day switching.

Title: Phase 3: Execution & Daily Logging Flow
Description: Student consumes meal (e.g. Moong Chilla) -> Taps 'Mark Eaten (+50 XP)' -> Daily Command Center updates in real-time -> Consumed protein bar advances -> Leftover budget recalculates -> Streak count increments.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Logging latency < 100ms; instant visual feedback and XP animation.

Title: Phase 4: Bulk Procurement & Campus Retention Flow
Description: Student clicks 'Generate 7-Day Grocery List' -> Receives aggregate raw haul (500g sattu, 14 eggs, 400g oats) -> Purchases in bulk at Kirana store -> Competes on hostel squad leaderboard -> Shares monthly Fitness Wrapped card on Instagram/WhatsApp.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Weekly grocery list export used by >= 35% of active cohort.

Title: Deterministic Biometric Target Engine
Description: Calculates BMR via Mifflin-St Jeor formula: BMR = (10*wt) + (6.25*ht) - (5*age) + 5 (M) / -161 (F). TDEE = BMR * Activity (1.2 to 1.725). Target Protein = 1.6g–2.0g per kg bodyweight, constrained by student budget. Output: POST /api/onboarding/profile.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Calculations accurate within 1 kcal and 0.1g protein; JSON response latency < 200ms.

Title: Heuristic Knapsack Budget Protein Solver
Description: Solves greedy knapsack sorted by protein-per-rupee density (P/₹ = protein_g / price_inr). Constraints: Total Cost <= Daily Budget INR; Servings <= Max daily safety tolerance (max 1.5 servings soya, max 4 eggs). Output: POST /api/optimizer/solve.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Deterministic output; never exceeds declared budget; execution time < 50ms.

Title: 7-Day Day-Wise Scheduled Meal Planner
Description: Provides 7 distinct daily rotational plans (Day 1 Monday to Day 7 Sunday) across 5 budget tiers and 3 dietary modes. Features 10 authentic recipes (Moong Chilla, Besan Chilla, Anda Bhurji, Paneer Bhurji, Soya Keema, Chicken Curry, Tawa Fish). Output: GET /api/meals/plan.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Sub-50ms tab switching; 7 unique meal recipes avoiding taste fatigue.

Title: Bulk 7-Day Grocery Generator
Description: Aggregates weekly raw weights for 7 days of scheduled meals. Identifies bulk procurement savings (e.g. 30-egg tray saves ₹60; wholesale 1kg sattu pouch saves 40%). Formatted for mobile Kirana shopping. Output: GET /api/meals/grocery-list.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: 100% exact mathematical sum of weekly meal ingredients; copy-to-clipboard support.

Title: Real-Time Command Center Dashboard
Description: Tracks real-time consumed macros vs daily targets. Initialized at 0% consumed protein and full daily budget remaining. Single-tap meal logging awarding +50 XP and updating SQLite meal_logs table. Output: GET /api/meals/today-summary, POST /api/meals/log.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Zero state drift; instant optimistic UI updates on logging.

Title: Gen-Z Gamification & Campus Squads
Description: XP engine (+150 onboarding, +50 meal, +100 milestone). Levels from Iron Cadet (Lvl 1) to Campus Beast (Lvl 5). Privacy-first hostel squads showing consistency streaks and XP only; weight is strictly confidential. Output: GET /api/genz/xp, GET /api/genz/squads.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Gamification engine updates XP and level atomically; zero private biometric leaks.

Title: Conversational AI Fitness Buddy
Description: Context-aware conversational assistant backed by Google Gemini with rule-based fallback. Provides campus cooking hacks, mess survival advice, budget protein swaps, and exam week nutrition guidance. Output: POST /api/ai/chat.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Response time < 2.5s; 100% campus-relevant guidance with graceful fallback.

Title: Hostel Mess Menu Integration & Deficit Compensator
Description: Enables students to input or sync their hostel mess weekly menu schedule. Automatically estimates baseline protein yield from mess meals (~8–12g), computes remaining deficit, and generates pocket-money snack boosters. Output: POST /api/genz/mess-menu-sync.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Accurately offsets mess deficit with <= ₹35/day supplementary snacks.

Title: API Latency & Client-Side Responsiveness
Description: API endpoints (knapsack solver, 7-day meal plan) must return within 300ms. Client-side day tabs (Day 1 to Day 7) must switch in under 50ms without full DOM re-renders or page reloads.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: p95 API response latency < 300ms; tab switch render latency < 50ms.

Title: Mobile-First Responsive Layout
Description: 100% of user flows, forms, modals, tables, and dashboards fully operational on 360px–420px mobile screens with thumb-friendly buttons and sticky bottom navigation.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Zero horizontal scroll on 360px viewports; 100% touch target compliance.

Title: Asset Reliability & Image Fallbacks
Description: All recipe and food photography served via reliable CDN URLs. Every image tag equipped with client-side onerror fallback handlers to ensure zero broken image placeholders.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: 0 broken image icons across all budget tiers and days.

Title: Security, Authentication & Data Privacy
Description: HMAC-SHA256 JWT session tokens. Parameterized SQLite queries preventing SQL injection. Strict privacy boundary: student body weights and biometric notes are strictly excluded from public squad leaderboards.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Zero SQL injection vulnerabilities; 100% confidential biometric masking.

Title: Serverless Availability & Zero Cold Starts
Description: Deployed on Vercel Serverless Architecture with 99.9% uptime SLA. Lightweight bundle ensures negligible cold start latency (< 500ms on first invoke).
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: 99.9% uptime SLA on production domain https://proto-mania-jms1.vercel.app/.

Title: Risk: Local Campus Food Price Inflation
Description: Kirana egg, sattu, and paneer rates vary across cities and campus gates, threatening budget optimizer accuracy.
Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Mitigation: Built 'Campus Kirana Custom Price Override' feature allowing students to customize local commodity prices.

Target_KPI_or_Acceptance_Standard: Mitigation: Overhauled meal planner from single static day into a 7-day day-wise schedule with 10 rotating authentic recipes.
